subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: What Is Supply Chain Risk
description: A quick, practical guide to What Is Supply Chain Risk.

hook.text: A fire at a single chip factory in Japan shut down car production worldwide for months. One factory.

buildup.text: Supply chain risk is the possibility that any disruption along the chain will block the flow of goods.

discovery.text: Risks come from suppliers, logistics, demand shifts, regulations, natural disasters, and cyberattacks.

twist.text: Modern supply chains are long and lean. Efficiency removed buffers—the same buffers that absorb shocks.

climax.text: Companies that ignore supply chain risk save money in good times and lose fortunes in bad times.

punchline.text: The risk you don't plan for is the one that hits hardest.

quiz.question: Why are modern supply chains more vulnerable to disruptions?
options: Efficiency removed the buffers that absorb shocks
